messages:
Lina (Marketing): Heads-up: we're planning to push the public launch post tomorrow morning. Need final ok on three items: changelog permalink, docs quickstart example for the new kv behavior, and the webinar registration routing. Can folks confirm? :eyes:
Diego (Engineering): Changelog is up. Permalink: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/changelog/2.1.0#kv-cache-strict. Added a short non-technical blurb in /release/summary too.
Lina (Marketing): Nice. We'll use that link in the blog and the social thread. Priya, are you happy with the non-tech blurb for the hero paragraph?
Priya (Product): Yep — skimmed it. Small wording suggestion: change "deterministic caching" to "deterministic KV caching" so it's clearer. I'll paste an edit in a sec.
Ruth (Design): Assets ready: hero image + benchmark chart (latency/cost delta). Would like the changelog anchor included in the press kit doc so reporters can link.
Maya (Sales Ops): Webinar signups should go to SFDC campaign Launch_2_1 and tag channel=announce_email. For paid trials, tag as "priority_followup" if they select "help migrating" on the form. I'll post the registration URL with utm params after this thread.
Lina (Marketing): Perfect. Can we also have an RSVP landing page with UTM for Twitter and another for email? I want to split inbound attribution.
Maya (Sales Ops): Done. Registration URLs:
- Email: https://events.redwood-inference.com/reg?utm_source=announce_email&utm_campaign=launch_2_1
- Social: https://events.redwood-inference.com/reg?utm_source=social_announce&utm_campaign=launch_2_1
Both funnel into the same campaign but different initial source tags.
Diego (Engineering): Quick docs note: Sam (DevEx) is adding a one-line snippet demonstrating `--kv-cache-strict` usage in the quickstart. I can merge it once CI passes. No code changes required for hosted users.
Lina (Marketing): Great — we need that snippet merged before we publish so the blog links to it. ETA?
Diego (Engineering): PR in flight, CI green on my machine. If reviewers are free, should be merged within 2 hours.
Priya (Product): Also: webinar slot confirmed at 9am PT, agenda: 20m demo, 15m benchmarks, 10m Q&A. Lina, can we use "demo + benchmarks" in the banner?
Lina (Marketing): Yes. Banner CTA: "Register for demo + benchmarks, 9am PT". I'll draft email copy tomorrow AM.
Ruth (Design): Adding CTA variant images for email and social now.
ReleaseBot: Scheduled rollout: publish at 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT) with canary on dedicated pool. Monitor window 30m.
Diego (Engineering): Canary started in staging at 1718810200, no regressions observed. Monitoring dashboards hooked. If tail latency exceeds 10% vs baseline, automatic rollback triggers.
Maya (Sales Ops): FYI — automated mapping for registrants to Slack channel #sales-inbound is ready. Attendees flagged as MQL if they join and meet product-fit checkbox.
Lina (Marketing): Final preflight checklist: 1) changelog permalink ✅, 2) docs snippet merged (tracking), 3) webinar RSVP URLs ✅, 4) assets ✅, 5) routing automations ✅. If docs merge completes, we're green to publish. I'll post final publish message here when I hit the button.
Diego (Engineering): Merged the docs snippet at 1718810400. Quick sanity note added explaining memory tradeoff.
Lina (Marketing): Awesome — publishing in 10. Will ping with live links and shortened URLs. :rocket:
